decisions.reason: The encrypted second channel remains central to the firm's strategy of binding mobile communication, and with industry growth and slack there is no performance shortfall to trigger search, even though it has not been visible on the website since 2019.

Mobile PDF signing supports the stated move toward online contract signing and costs little to maintain, although its absence from the website suggests it may have been folded into the broader signing offer.

The email-to-app robot is a niche add-on with uncertain results and no visibility since 2018, so it likely falls below aspiration, and its resources are better redirected to core identity development.
Payment-network compliance matches the firm's regulatory value proposition, and available slack lets it carry the suite despite weak visibility and its peripheral fit with the core identity offer.
